# awscc_polly_lexicon (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Polly::Lexicon. A pronunciation lexicon that stores custom pronunciations for speech synthesis.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The content of the PLS lexicon in string format.
- `name` (String) The name of the lexicon. Must be an alphanumeric string up to 20 characters long.

### Read-Only

- `alphabet` (String) The phonetic alphabet used in the lexicon. Valid values are ipa and x-sampa.
- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the lexicon.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `language_code` (String) The language code that the lexicon applies to.
- `last_modified` (String) The date the lexicon was last modified (ISO 8601 timestamp).
- `lexemes_count` (Number) The number of lexemes in the lexicon.
- `size` (Number) The total size of the lexicon, in characters.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_polly_lexicon.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the lexicon

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_polly_lexicon.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_polly_lexicon.example "arn"
```
